Shravani, who lives in Madhapur, called to book a general service for her split AC and requested a technician visit at 10:00 AM the next day. She provided her email address, sravani.audit@example.invalid, and asked for the appointment and calendar event to be confirmed. The agent stated that the slot was available, the service price was ₹599, and Madhapur was within the service area. The agent also stated that an email confirmation and calendar event had been created. Shravani accepted the ₹599 price and requested final confirmation of the service, location, time, and email details. The agent confirmed the appointment for 30 October from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM in Madhapur and stated that an email invite was sent. Shravani acknowledged the confirmation and ended the call courteously.
